name: DataVolt Bukhara Data Center
notes: Data Center Dynamics reported DataVolt's Uzbekistan plan includes a 40MW Bukhara facility, while official Uzbek ICT material described planned construction of new data centers in Bukhara region.

name: Shanghai LinkWise Bukhara Data Center
notes: Kun.uz reported a Chinese developer proposal for data centers in Bukhara and Surkhandarya with total projected power consumption of 300MW and an estimated $300m investment; capacity is treated as project total rather than confirmed installed IT load.

name: Fergana Region Data Center Program
developer: Government of Uzbekistan / private investors not specified
notes: Official Uzbek ICT-sector material states that four data centers were planned in Tashkent, Bukhara, Fergana, and Tashkent regions; no specific Fergana developer or capacity was identified in public sources searched.

name: Jizzakh Data Center
notes: Official bank and Uzbek ICT sources reported launch of a Jizzakh data center intended to support digital services and regional IT infrastructure; public sources did not state MW capacity.

name: Qashqadaryo Data Center Cooperation Discussions
notes: Official Uzbek ICT-week coverage said Qashqadaryo officials discussed prospects for cooperation with Kazteleport in data center creation and maintenance. This is an early-stage cooperation item, not a confirmed construction project.

name: DataVolt Karakalpakstan AI Data Center
notes: Trade press reported DataVolt plans a 500MW AI data center in Karakalpakstan to use renewable energy; reported project cost was about $3bn.

name: Keycore AI Data Center
notes: Data Center Dynamics reported Keycore's planned AI data center in Karakalpakstan would host Nvidia H200 servers and consume more than 16MW.

name: Samarkand Data Center
developer: Uzbekistan government / unnamed investor or operator
notes: Official Uzbek outsourcing portal reported plans for a major data center in Samarkand; public source searched did not disclose MW capacity.
